items.message: Ancestor check uses `_try` return value as a boolean, but `merge-base --is-ancestor` exits non-zero (not a missing-output signal) when the commit is not an ancestor.
In `reconcile`/`push`, `_carry` is called for `ACKNOWLEDGED` before records are added, but in `absorb` it is called after — order is inconsistent and could matter if a record and a note share a path.
